content.short: Kryptonite is the premier liquid staking and lending protocol on Sei, featuring the stSEI liquid derivative.
content.description:
Kryptonite is the leading decentralized liquid staking and money market protocol built natively on the Sei Network. The platform enables users to stake their SEI tokens to receive stSEI, a liquid staking derivative that earns rewards while remaining highly composable within the Sei DeFi ecosystem. Functioning as Sei's primary bond market, Kryptonite allows participants to use their stSEI as collateral to borrow stablecoins or leverage their positions to amplify staking yields.

Powered by the SEILOR governance token, the protocol provides a secure and transparent framework for decentralized asset management. By leveraging Sei's high-speed infrastructure, Kryptonite delivers a seamless user experience with sub-second finality. As a core component of the network's liquidity layer, Kryptonite is essential for onboarding new users and providing the financial tools needed for a robust and efficient decentralized economy on Sei.
content.meta: Kryptonite provides liquid staking and decentralized lending services on the Sei Network through stSEI.
